Package cafe94.system.controller.staff

Class ChefDashboardController

java.lang.Object
cafe94.system.controller.staff.ChefDashboardController
public class ChefDashboardController extends Object
Controller for the Chef Dashboard in the Cafe94 system.

This controller enables chefs to:

  • View and filter outstanding orders that require preparation
  • Mark orders as completed, updating their status and optionally assigning drivers
  • Add, edit, and remove daily specials from the menu
It integrates with shared utilities such as OutstandingOrderHelper for order table configuration and uses DataSaver for persistence.

  • Method Details

    • setup

      public void setup(OrderManaged orderManaged, List<MenuItem> menuItemsFromFile, List<MenuItem> specialsFromFile)
      Initializes the Chef Dashboard with order management and menu data. This method should be called after FXML loading to provide necessary context.
      Parameters:
      orderManaged - The order manager instance containing all orders.
      menuItemsFromFile - The full list of menu items available in the system.
      specialsFromFile - The current list of daily special menu items.

    • initialize

      private void initialize()
      Initializes the Chef Dashboard after the FXML elements are loaded.

      Sets up table columns, listeners, data bindings, and combo box filters for managing daily specials and outstanding orders.

    • loadOrders

      private void loadOrders(String filterType)
      Loads and filters the chef-relevant outstanding orders into the orders table.
      Parameters:
      filterType - The filter selected from the dropdown (e.g., "All Outstanding").

    • handleAddFromMenu

      private void handleAddFromMenu()
      Adds a selected menu item to the daily specials list, avoiding duplicates. Saves the updated daily specials to file.

    • handleAddNewSpecial

      private void handleAddNewSpecial()
      Adds a new manually-entered item to the daily specials list. Validates name and price format before saving.

    • handleRemoveSpecial

      private void handleRemoveSpecial()
      Removes the selected item from the daily specials list. Updates the persistent storage after removal.

    • handleLogout

      private void handleLogout()
      Logs the chef out and navigates back to the login screen.

    • handleMarkOrderComplete

      private void handleMarkOrderComplete()
      Marks a selected PENDING_PREP order as ready.

      Updates the order status to the next logical step, assigns a driver if it's a delivery order, saves the updated orders, and refreshes the UI.
